missions.name: Ghost Signal
missions.brief: Download intelligence from three terminals. Avoid patrol cones and extract north. Shooting and sprinting reveal your position.

missions.name: Black Site
missions.brief: Eight patrol guards control the checkpoint district. Use distractions and rear takedowns to open a safe route.

missions.name: Silent Exit
missions.brief: Ten guards patrol the final compound. Recover all data before the six-minute deadline and escape.
